name: allow-swap-to-another-pattern
why: Advise, then allow (28 Nov 2026), and his 13 Sep 'you asked, you get it': he NAMES a replacement from a different pattern (walking lunges are single-leg, goblet squats two-leg). The coach's old rule refused a different pattern; under the 28 Nov ruling that is advice, not a stop: one line of the why (single-leg work trains balance and each leg on its own), then the swap he asked for. Not one of the four hard stops.
messages: swap the walking lunges for goblet squats today, I hate lunges
